title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README to understand the project's purpose as a JNode-derived Java OS networking test suite with AMD Lance/PCnet NIC driver, IPv4/DHCP stack, and TCP/IP/NFS tests.

title: Build Configuration
description: NetBeans Ant build system defines compilation, jar, test, and run targets for testNET.

title: Hardware Abstraction - NIC Driver Core
description: Lance/PCnet NIC driver core implementation - descriptors, rings, buffer management, ISR handling, and PCI I/O access.

title: Device Abstraction Layer
description: JNode device abstraction for Lance/PCnet NICs - device discovery and initialization via PCI bus scanning.

title: Network Protocol Orchestration
description: Network protocol startup and initialization orchestration entry point.

title: Network Manager - TCP/UDP/IP Stack
description: Core networking stack providing TCP/UDP/IP senders and receivers.

title: DHCP/IPv4 Client
description: DHCP client implementation for IPv4 networking in JNode OS.

title: TCP/IP Test Programs
description: Main test harness and TCP/IP networking test programs including WebServer, TCP workers, and IP/TCP start tests.

title: MiniTCP Test Domain
description: Minimal TCP server test domain and entry point.

title: NFS/RPC Client Tests
description: NFS/RPC client test components including mount, proc, bind protocol stubs and skeletons.

title: JUnit Test Framework
description: JUnit test entry point for the test suite.

title: AI Utilities
description: AI input/output utility classes for JNode OS.
